column1: # gsa-bridge endpoint table - the only file you maintain.
#   name         short label used in logs and status output
#   fqdn         the REAL hostname; the Windows relay dials this by name so GSA intercepts
#   port         the REAL port; preserved end to end so connection strings never change
#   wsl_addr     loopback address the WSL relay listens on (must be unique per fqdn)
#   bridge_port  loopback port the Windows relay listens on (must be unique overall)
# Add a row with wsl_addr/bridge_port left as "-" and run:  wsl/sync_hosts.py --assign
# Never renumber existing rows; /etc/hosts and any running clients depend on them.
